pr.title: Fix Delphi filter deadlock: redact proposals instead of withholding
pr.description:
The Delphi visibility filter drops CONSENSUS_PROPOSE messages entirely from
reviewers who haven't ACK'd/NACK'd, creating a deadlock when reviewers depend
on polling to discover proposals. Replace full withholding with redacted
pass-through: strip body and payload summary but preserve message header so
reviewers know a proposal exists.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: test_propose_withheld_from_unreviewed_reviewer (updated), test_propose_redacted_preserves_header (new), test_propose_visible_after_reviewer_evaluates (unchanged), test_non_reviewer_sees_propose (unchanged)
- Manual: Run a BRC pipeline and verify reviewer_code receives redacted PROPOSE messages before ACKing
